name: Sofía Niño de Rivera
note: First woman + first Spanish Netflix special (Expuesta 2016). Ad-copywriter turned comic via NYC clubs. Self-deprecation + regional accents + Guadalupe material. Death threats in Chihuahua for provincial jokes.
